visualCharacteristics.purpose: Office location services list: intro heading, grid of icon + service title + description, and a closing CTA button

contentPattern.structure: optional first row: intro heading (single cell). Service rows: icon cell | body cell with the service title (heading or bold paragraph) and description. Optional last row: CTA link/button only. A heading-only row after service rows starts a new group
contentPattern.rows: intro heading, one row per service, optional CTA row

usage: Use on tax office location pages for the 'H&R Block tax pros know taxes' services list. Default lays services out in an auto-fill grid; alt forces two columns (used where the office lists extra services that wrap onto a second line). Section background comes from section metadata Style, not a block class.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any short list of offered services with small icons and a single closing CTA. Use cards-icon for centred icon rows.
